introHtml: Pink electric fans stand out at events like breast cancer awareness walks, women's health expos, and summer festivals where a pop of color draws attention to your brand. Available in styles from the compact Circle Hand Fan to the battery-powered Prisma Clip-on Fan, these custom pink electric fans can be imprinted with your logo using pad printing or full-color digital transfer. Choose a translucent or solid pink finish to match your campaign palette.
